test_title: SSC CHSL Exam 2023 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 Nov, 2023 Shift 1).
subject: general
question:
In email, which of the following mode(s) is/are included in the Post Office Protocol (POP)?

I. Delete Mode

II. Keep Mode
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 4**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Post Office Protocol (POP) includes both **Delete Mode** and **Keep Mode**.
 
• **Delete Mode** allows the email to be deleted from the server once it has been downloaded.&
